title: A pool of blocks
description:
Hand out equal-sized blocks quickly with a free list.

```
pool of 4 blocks of 32 bytes
alloc a b c d -> pool empty
free b, alloc e -> e reuses b's block
```
hints: At the start, link every block: block `i` points at block `i + 1`, and the last at `nullptr` (lesson 6.03).
Each block must be at least `sizeof(FreeBlock)` bytes and suitably aligned to hold the link.
requirements: `class Pool(blockSize, count)` with `allocate()` and `deallocate(void*)`, both O(1).
The free list is stored inside the free blocks themselves (each holds a pointer to the next free one).
`deallocate` of a pointer outside the pool is refused (an assertion is fine).
stretch: Make it a template `Pool<T>` with `create(args...)` and `destroy(T*)` that call constructors and destructors.
